sub_parameters.name: Description
sub_parameters.description: The description. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

sub_parameters.name: DestCidrIp
sub_parameters.description: The destination IPv4 CIDR block. Both CIDR format and IPv4 format IP address range are supported.

sub_parameters.name: Direction
sub_parameters.description:
The authorization direction. Valid values:

- egress: outbound.
- ingress: inbound.

sub_parameters.name: IpProtocol
sub_parameters.description:
The protocol type. Valid values: 
         
- TCP: TCP protocol.
- UDP: UDP protocol.
- ICMP: ICMP protocol.
- ICMPv6: ICMPv6 protocol.
- ALL: All protocols are supported.

sub_parameters.name: Ipv6DestCidrIp
sub_parameters.description:
The destination IPv6 CIDR block. Both CIDR format and IPv6 format IP address range are supported. 

> This parameter and the `DestCidrIp` parameter cannot be set at the same time. Settings for these two parameters are mutually exclusive.

sub_parameters.name: Ipv6SourceCidrIp
sub_parameters.description:
The source IPv6 CIDR block. Both CIDR format and IPv6 format IP address range are supported.
> This parameter and the `DestCidrIp` parameter cannot be set at the same time. Settings for these two parameters are mutually exclusive.

sub_parameters.name: Policy
sub_parameters.description:
The access permissions. Valid values: 
         
- Accept: Allows access.
- Drop: Deny access.

sub_parameters.name: PortRange
sub_parameters.description:
The range of destination ports that correspond to the protocols for the security group. Valid values:
         
- TCP/UDP protocol: Valid values are 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.
- ICMP protocol: -1/-1.
- ICMPv6: -1/-1.
- ALL: -1/-1.

sub_parameters.name: Priority
sub_parameters.description: The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100.

sub_parameters.name: SourceCidrIp
sub_parameters.description: The source IPv4 CIDR block. Both CIDR format and IPv4 format IP address range are supported.

sub_parameters.name: SourcePortRange
sub_parameters.description:
The range of source ports that correspond to the protocols for the security group. Valid values:
         
- TCP/UDP protocol: Valid values are 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.
- ICMP protocol: -1/-1.
- ICMPv6: -1/-1.
- ALL: -1/-1.
